Hạ cánh khẩn cấp

A rapid descent by an aircraft in response to an emergency situation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Hạ cánh khẩn cấp?

In this glossary, Hạ cánh khẩn cấp refers to: A rapid descent by an aircraft in response to an emergency situation.

How is Hạ cánh khẩn cấp used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Phi công, bắt đầu hạ cánh khẩn cấp do mất áp suất cabin."

Why does Hạ cánh khẩn cấp matter in aviation?

Hạ cánh khẩn cấp matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Hạ cánh khẩn cấp?

Hạ cánh khẩn cấp is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Hạ cánh khẩn cấp belong to?

In this glossary, Hạ cánh khẩn cấp is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition
